title: SEO fundamentals
goal: Help people and search engines understand a page.
explanation: Write useful content for a clear audience. Use a descriptive page title, meaningful headings and crawlable links. Search visibility is not guaranteed by adding keywords.
A meta description can help describe a page in search results, but the search engine may choose different text. Avoid duplicate pages with conflicting URL signals.
Ensure important pages can be reached and return appropriate HTTP statuses. robots.txt is not an access-control mechanism; private content needs authentication and authorisation.
code:
<title>Website design in Johannesburg | Studio Example</title>
<meta name="description" content="See our website design services, process and recent projects.">
exercise: Write a specific title and description for your portfolio services page.
hint: Describe the actual page. Do not promise a ranking position.

quiz.question: Can robots.txt protect confidential records?
options: No, it is not access control
Only if the filename is secret
quiz.explanation: Confidential content needs server-enforced access restrictions.
